name: Domitian
title: Caesar Domitianus Augustus
summary: Domitian ( də-MISH-ən, -⁠ee-ən; Latin: Domitianus was Roman emperor from 81 to 96. The son of Vespasian and the younger brother of Titus, his two predecessors on the throne, he was the last member of the Flavian dynasty. Described as "a ruthless but efficient autocrat", his authoritarian style of ruling put him at sharp odds with the Senate, whose powers he drastically curtailed.
notes: Reign: 15 years and 4 days. Domitian's memory was damned (damnatio memoriae) by the Senate. Later historians often repeated the hostile senatorial tradition, though his administration was efficient. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Domitian
